attempted_claim: Let k be algebraically closed of characteristic 0 and let S=A(E,tau) be the four-dimensional Sklyanin algebra with quartic elliptic curve E in P^3 and translation tau of exact order 2, so S is module-finite over its center Z with PI-degree 2. Prove or disprove that the Azumaya locus of S equals the smooth locus of Y=MaxSpec Z. A complete answer gives an explicit presentation of Z with generators and relations, the PI-degree, equations for the singular locus of Y, and either a proof of equality or an explicit witness maximal ideal m of Z with a certificate of its smooth versus singular status, its Azumaya versus non-Azumaya status, and the dimensions and count of all simple S-modules annihilated by m.
claim_type: Azumaya-equals-smooth coincidence at excluded small order
decisive_failure: No center presentation, PI-degree certificate, singular-locus equations, or Azumaya/smooth witness was established; numeric SVD scans and exact rational checks cover only sampled parameters, and the Newton graph search over the bilinear point-scheme system is not an exhaustive proof of absence of an order-2 specialization.
